lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.title: HORRIFIC INCURSION
stratagems.flavor: Accompanied by a burst of sensory torment, a sudden deployment can shatter the prey’s discipline.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived from Reserves this turn.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) within 12" of and visible to your unit: that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

rule.title: Warp Portals
rule.text:
At the end of your opponent’s turn, you can select a number of HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS and MUTILATORS units from your army (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:
BATTLE SIZENUMBER OF UNITSIncursionUp to 1 unitStrike ForceUp to 2 unitsOnslaughtUp to 3 units
Once you have made your selections, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.title: Infernal Fulgurite
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Once per battle, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

enhancements.title: Eye of the Warp
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.title: Akshur’s Binding Runes
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

enhancements.title: Tzagulla
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model with the Deep Strike ability only. Improve the Attacks, Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s weapons by 1. In addition, each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves, until the end of the turn, improve the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s weapons by 1.

stratagems.title: EMPYRIC DISLOCATION
stratagems.flavor: These warriors have not quite escaped the grip of the Warp, remaining slightly incorporeal in a way that causes enemy fire to pass harmlessly through them.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.

stratagems.title: ARMOUR OF CORRUPTION
stratagems.flavor: Drawn to the largest and toughest warriors by their inherent sense of might and superiority, overspilling warp energies make their conceit a resilient reality.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS
lines.text: You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.

stratagems.title: WARP FLICKER
stratagems.flavor: Momentary flares of empyric energy wreathe this unit, causing them to stutter through time and space more swiftly.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.title: WARP-TAINTED
stratagems.flavor: Immaterial energies still cling to these warriors like tattered shrouds, leaving sites of significance tainted by their touch and haunted by insubstantial spectres.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.title: SIEGEBREAKER STRIKE
stratagems.flavor: These warriors have drilled relentlessly in the art of laying down murderous fire against dug-in foes the moment they teleport into battle.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: Up to two HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.title: PORTAL OF SPITE
stratagems.flavor: The warp rift through which these warriors reach the battlefield has been directed toward chosen prey by a vengeful daemonic entity.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.

rule.title: Desperate Devotion
rule.text:
Each time a DAMNED unit from your army with the Dark Pacts ability is selected to make a Normal or Advance move or declare a charge (excluding units that arrived from Reserves this turn), it can make a Desperate Pact (see below). If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 2 to Charge rolls made for that unit.
Desperate Pacts
Each time a unit makes a Desperate Pact, it must first take a Leadership test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds before any effects of that Desperate Pact are resolved.
KEYWORDS
TRAITOR GUARDSMEN SQUAD units from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

enhancements.title: Amulet of Tainted Vigour
enhancements.text: DARK APOSTLE model only. In your Command phase, you can return up to D3 destroyed DAMNED models (excluding CHARACTER models) to the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.title: Cultist’s Brand
enhancements.text: DARK APOSTLE or DAMNED model only. If every other model in the bearer’s unit (excluding Dark Disciples) is DAMNED, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.title: Incendiary Goad
enhancements.text: DARK APOSTLE or DAMNED model only. While the bearer’s unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by DAMNED models in that unit, and while that unit is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons as well.

enhancements.title: Warped Foresight
enhancements.text: DARK APOSTLE or DAMNED model only. While the bearer is leading a unit with the Scouts 6" ability, every model in the bearer’s unit has the Scouts 6" ability.

stratagems.title: CHOSEN FOR GLORY
stratagems.flavor: Within the massed ranks of a heretic cult, only a few are marked for greatness.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.title: SELFLESS DEMISE
stratagems.flavor: The zealous followers of the Dark Gods are devoted to the last. As death comes they strike a desperate final blow in hope of reward.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6 on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.

stratagems.title: INFERNAL SACRIFICE
stratagems.flavor: Those in thrall to the Dark Gods will gladly sacrifice their lives to draw the eye of their darkling patrons.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (in addition to any suffered for failing the resulting Leadership test), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, until the end of the phase, improve the Strength characteristic of those weapons by 1 as well.

stratagems.title: CRAZED FOCUS
stratagems.flavor: Sven in the grip of frothing madness, these heretics are murderous in the extreme

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.

stratagems.title: RECKLESS HASTE
stratagems.flavor: Consumed by a desire to spill blood, these fanatical heretics hurl themselves towards the foe.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DAMNED unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.title: MORTAL THRALLS
stratagems.flavor: Disciples of the Chaos Gods think nothing of sacrificing their lesser thralls to protect those of greater worth.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected ts targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks, and one friendly DAMNED unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, while your DAMNED unit is on the battlefield, each time your opponent would make a Wound roll for an attack that targets your HERETIC ASTARTES unit, if your DAMNED unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no roll is made; instead, your DAMNED unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

rule.title: Soul Forge Boons
rule.text:
HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE units from your army gain the DAEMON keyword.
HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE, LORD DISCORDANT and VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE units from your army gain the SOUL FORGE keyword.
SOUL FORGE units from your army have a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.title: Wyredjinn
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.title: Cybinfernal Font
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Models in the bearer’s unit have the SOUL FORGE keyword.

enhancements.title: Mark of the Soul Forges
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Each time the bearer makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.title: Crown of Worms
enhancements.text: WARPSMITH model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer’s Warpsmith, Master of Mechanisms and Enrage Machine Spirits abilities.

stratagems.title: TOUCH OF THE ARKIFANE
stratagems.category: Cult of the Arkifane – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The blessings of Vashtorr flow through these warriors’ weapons, infusing them with power and mutating them into still-deadlier forms.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain.

stratagems.title: BALEFIRE BOON
stratagems.category: Cult of the Arkifane – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Channelling the infernal flames of the soul forges, this unit tears through its victims with blows and blasts that melt the toughest armour.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.title: SOUL-TALLY OFFERING
stratagems.category: Cult of the Arkifane – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Offering up so great a sacrificial victim will surely win favour with the Arkifane, or go some way toward settling the looming debts already incurred to him.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: BIOMECHANOID REGENERATION
stratagems.category: Cult of the Arkifane – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Metal and muscle, wire and sinew flow together, reknitting battle damage with sparking clots of repulsive mutant growth.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.

stratagems.title: FORGE-FIRE SURGE
stratagems.category: Cult of the Arkifane – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Warp-tainted motive force and empyric plasma flows through engine and living entity alike, driving them on even as it scours them from within.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.

stratagems.title: UNHOLY FORTITUDE
stratagems.category: Cult of the Arkifane – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Responding swiftly to incoming fire, the bound entity within this daemon engine raises arcane wards to soak up the foe’s fury.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

rule.title: Slaves to None
rule.text:
HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army lose the Dark Pacts ability.
Ranged weapons equipped by HERETIC ASTARTES models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.
When mustering your army, you cannot use the Cults of the Dark Gods rule.
Vendetta
At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Vendetta target. Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army (excluding DAMNED models) makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Twisted Doctrine
In your Movement phase, each time you set up or select a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding Battle-shocked units) from your army to move, it can choose to Default to Doctrine. If it does, it must first take a Battle-shock test. Then, select one of the following:
- Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
- Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.title: Weaponised Hatred
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Once per battle round, after your Vendetta target is destroyed, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can select one enemy unit visible to the bearer. That enemy unit becomes your Vendetta target until you select a new one.

enhancements.title: Eyes of the Hunter
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.title: Fratricidal Trophies
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. In a turn in which the bearer’s unit chose to Default to Doctrine, until the end of the turn, each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.title: Empyric Symbiote
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

stratagems.title: NEVER OUTGUNNED
stratagems.flavor: Centuries of combined combat experience enable these Renegade killers to eliminate any target, bringing down resilient foes by targeting weak points or reducing hordes of enemy infantry to bloody mist with rapid volleys.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

stratagems.title: VENGEFUL DESTRUCTION
stratagems.flavor: Hatred is a powerful motivator. Those who cross Renegade Space Marines rarely live long enough to regret their actions.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (excluding DAMNED units) or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: UNDYING HATRED
stratagems.flavor: Freed from the Emperor’s yoke, these warriors are motivated only by bitter hatred, channelling their ire into every brutal strike: even their final one.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.title: RENEGADE CLAIM
stratagems.flavor: Renegades do not relinquish their prizes easily.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.title: CORRUPTED MUNITIONS
stratagems.flavor: Without traditional methods of resupply and rearmament, Renegades must plunder or barter for their ammunition. Whether seized from the holds of captive vessels or acquired from daemonic arms dealers or xenos black marketeers, these munitions are horrifically effective.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.

stratagems.title: REAVERS’ REACTION
stratagems.flavor: Reacting to incoming fire, traitorous infantry adjust their battle plan without breaking stride, moving to take cover or closing in upon their assailants with vengeance in mind.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

rule.title: Iron Fortitude
rule.text: Each time a ranged attack targets a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.title: Bastion Plate
enhancements.text: CHAOS LORD model only (excluding JUMP PACK models). Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for the bearer’s unit, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.title: Iron Artifice
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. The bearers weapons have the [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] and [ANTI-FORTIFICATION 4+] abilities.

enhancements.title: Ironbound Enmity
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack while within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.title: Warp Tracer
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.title: PERSISTENT ASSAILANTS
stratagems.flavor: These iron-willed warriors refuse to retreat, even i the face of overwhelming odds. Mounting losses serve only to drive them forward

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more attacks this phase and has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit is Below Half-strength you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.title: BRUTAL ATTRITION
stratagems.flavor: These implacable soldiers weather the enemy's fury before striking back in kind, to devastating effect.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack is allocated to your unit, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6 (to maximum of six D6 per attacking unit): for each 4+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.title: PITILESS CANNONADE
stratagems.flavor: These warriors focus their ire upon a wounded foe, combining fire to fell their target in a cavalcade of destructive force.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit

stratagems.title: POINT-BLANK DESTRUCTION
stratagems.flavor: Even in the press of combat, the Heretic Astartes bring heavy weapons to bear, shattering fortifications and obliterating enemy infantry.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, your unit’s ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons) have the [PISTOL] ability.

stratagems.title: STEADFAST DETERMINATION
stratagems.flavor: These warriors possess endless endurance and are capable of weathering untold hardships in order to destroy their foes.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.title: SIEGECRAFT
stratagems.flavor: Veterans of countless grinding sieges, these Heretic Astartes repel and pin down wave after wave of foes with rapid boltgun fire and accurate artillery.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of your opponents Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

rule.title: Debt to the Soul Forge
rule.text:
Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army makes a Dark Pact, it can invoke its contract. If it does, subtract 1 from the resulting Leadership test when making that Dark Pact, and until the end of the phase:
- Each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
- Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

enhancements.title: Forge’s Blessing
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

enhancements.title: Invigorated Mechatendrils
enhancements.text: WARPSMITH model only. Add 4" to the bearer’s Move characteristic.

enhancements.title: Tempting Addendum
enhancements.text:
HERETIC ASTARTES model only. Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army invokes its contract while within 3" of the bearer:
- If it suffers one or more mortal wounds as a result of that Dark Pact, add 1 to the number of mortal wounds it suffers.
- Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.title: Soul Harvester
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

stratagems.title: DESPERATE PLEDGE
stratagems.flavor: A daemon construct may beseech the Arkifane for further aid, adding to its soul debt in return for greater might.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.title: GLUT OF SOULS
stratagems.flavor: Wrh each soul harvested the bound daemon comes closer to settling its contract and earning freedom.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved (to a maximum of 6 wound).

stratagems.title: DAEMONIC POSSESSION
stratagems.flavor: Those steeped in techno-sorcery may trammel daemonic entities within mechanical constructs.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding DAEMON units).

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the DAEMON keyword.

stratagems.title: UNSTOPPABLE RAMPAGE
stratagems.flavor: The tortured machine spirits of Heretic Astartes vehicles are driven forward by their anguish.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase or Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes Normal, Advance or charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

stratagems.title: PREDATORY PURSUIT
stratagems.flavor: Corrupted Heretic Astartes Vehicles Pursue their prey with an animalistic determination.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall back move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.

stratagems.title: FEEDING FRENZY
stratagems.flavor: The daemonic entities at the heart of possessed vehicles hunger for the life force of their enemies.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that is within Engagement Range of your units Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, of that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, substract 1 from each of those tests.

rule.title: Focus of Hatred
rule.text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponents army to be your focus of hatred. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a HERETIC ASTARTES model from your army (excluding DAMNED models) makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.title: Eager for Vengeance
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, if the bearer’s unit Fell Back this turn, add 1 to the Hit roll, and each time you select your focus of hatred as a target of that unit’s charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.

enhancements.title: Eye of Abaddon
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your focus of hatred is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.title: Mark of Legend
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding DAMNED models). Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one saving throw made for the bearer.

enhancements.title: Warmaster’s Gift
enhancements.text: CHAOS LORD model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, an unmodified successful Wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.

stratagems.title: ENDLESS IRE
stratagems.category: Veterans of the Long War – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: No amount of bloodshed can truly satisfy this bitter champion's desire for vengeance.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units)

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.

stratagems.title: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
stratagems.category: Veterans of the Long War – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Such embittered warriors as these shrug off hails of enemy fire with arrogant disdain.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponents Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.title: BRINGERS OF DESPAIR
stratagems.category: Veterans of the Long War – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Fearful of countenance, these ancient warriors are redolent with warp power and radiate a horrifying aura of might.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.title: BLACK CRUSADE
stratagems.category: Veterans of the Long War – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: The Warmaster s Black Crusade grinds ever onwards without restraint or remorse.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.

stratagems.title: LET THE GALAXY BURN
stratagems.category: Veterans of the Long War – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: No barricade or fortification is proof against the vengeful fury of these hate-fuelled murderers.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.

stratagems.title: MILLENNIA OF EXPERIENCE
stratagems.category: Veterans of the Long War – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.flavor: Thousands of years of ceaseless conflict have forged these warriors into skilled and merciless killers.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

rule.title: Empyric Wellspring
rule.text:
- In your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit (excluding DAEMON units) is selected to shoot, if that unit makes a Dark Pact, that unit’s ranged attacks have +1 S.
- In the Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE/DAEMON PRINCE WITH WINGS unit (excluding KHORNE units) is selected to fight, if that unit makes a Dark Pact, that unit’s melee attacks have:
- +2 S.
- +1 AP.

enhancements.title: Touched by the Warp
enhancements.text:
HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding KHORNE models).
- This model has PSYKER.
- This model’s weapons have [PSYCHIC].

enhancements.title: Conduit of Chaos
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON model only (excluding KHORNE models). This model’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.title: INFERNAL VIGOUR
stratagems.flavor: With the unbound energies of the Warp surging through them, this infernal champion heals of their hurts as quickly as the enemy can inflict them.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit heals D3+1 wounds.

stratagems.title: FLESHY CURSE
stratagems.flavor: Chanting words of forbidden power, this heretic witch triggers a ghastly explosion of hypermutation within the bodies of foes, rapidly transforming them into heaving mounds of gibbering meat.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6: - On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. - On a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. - On a 5-6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are inflicted by a psychic attack.

stratagems.title: WREATHED IN WARPFLAME
stratagems.flavor: Secondary cantrips blossom out like poisoned flowers from the heart of this sorcerous manifestation, raining mutating flame upon the foe in roiling clouds.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is selected to shoot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

rule.title: Rain of Ruin
rule.text: Friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS units’ ranged attacks have [HEAVY].

enhancements.title: Pact of Destruction
enhancements.text:
WARPSMITH model only.
- When this unit uses its Dark Pacts ability, this unit can re-roll Leadership rolls.
- In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if this unit used its Dark Pacts ability and if those attacks destroyed an enemy model, this unit heals 3 wounds

enhancements.title: Eye of Oblivion
enhancements.text: WARPSMITH model only. When this unit is selected to shoot, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

stratagems.title: RUINATION’S BOUNTY
stratagems.flavor: As the murderous rain of projectiles redoubles and the fires of ruin burn higher, so the favour of the Dark Gods falls upon the architects of this devastation.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is selected to shoot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: When your unit uses the Dark Pacts ability, your unit’s ranged attacks have: - [LETHAL HITS]. - [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.title: SNARE OF FIRE
stratagems.flavor: Even as the foe attempts to escape the rain of ruination, or to close with the foes so cruelly winnowing their ranks, so these Havocs move to establish new sight lines and draw their victims into an inescapable crossfire.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HAVOCS unit.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That HAVOCS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.title: UNDYING HATRED
stratagems.flavor: Gripped by a maniacal need to annihilate their hated enemies, these killers will not easily succumb to the clutches of death.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

rule.title: Prey on the Weak
rule.text:
- Friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY units’ attacks that target a battle-shocked unit or a unit at or below half-strength can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
- When an enemy unit’s attacks target a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit, if that enemy unit is battle-shocked or at or below half-strength, those attacks have -1 to hit rolls.
This detachment has the NIGHTMARE tag and cannot be taken with another NIGHTMARE detachment.

enhancements.title: Shadowcowl Talisman
enhancements.text: CHAOS LORD WITH JUMP PACK model only. This unit has 5+ InSv.

enhancements.title: Pact of Cursed Pinions
enhancements.text:
LEADER: WARP TALONS
CHAOS LORD WITH JUMP PACK model only.
- This model has DAEMON.
- This model’s melee attacks have +1 A.

stratagems.title: PLUNGING TALONS
stratagems.flavor: With a last-second blast of speed from their jump packs, the Chaos Space Marines slam into their enemies blades-first.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.title: RAKING PASS

errata.title: Do a unit's abilities continue to function while they are embarked within a TRANSPORT?
errata.text:
Yes, within the restrictions specified by the ability itself. Embarked units are Not On The Battlefield (01.02.04), so any ability requiring visibility or measurement to another unit will fail.
Example: Azrael is attached to an Intercessor Squad unit and embarked within a TRANSPORT, and that TRANSPORT is making a shooting attack using the Firing Deck ability. While Azrael’s Supreme Grand Master ability is still technically active, it will have no effect, as the requirements of the ability are not met (the ability affects ‘weapons equipped by models’ in Azrael’s unit, and for the purposes of Firing Deck, the TRANSPORT itself is equipped with those weapons instead).

errata.title: If a rule says a unit can embark into a TRANSPORT in a turn that unit disembarked, does this ignore the core rules restriction on embarking in a turn that unit made a set up move (see 18.02)?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: Does my model or unit become engaged while moving through a enemy units engagement range during a move?
errata.text: No

errata.title: I have a rule that triggers when a mortal wound is allocated to a model, when does this happen?
errata.text: When you select a model in the Select Model step of Mortal Wounds (06.02).

errata.title: I failed hazard rolls from [Hazardous] weapons, do those mortal wounds have to be allocated to the models with the [HAZARDOUS] weapons?
errata.text: No, you allocate the mortal wounds to the unit as per Mortal Wounds (06.02). (This represents Bob the guardsmen picking up his fallen squad mates plasma gun or that the twisting power of James the Chaos Sorcerer pulling his followers into the warp.)

errata.title: If a rule says my unit must make a hazard roll does every model in the unit make a hazard roll?
errata.text: No, the unit would make 1 single hazard roll.

errata.title: If a unit makes any disembark move in a turn (i.e. Disembark move, Emergency Disembark move etc.) has it disembarked that turn?
errata.text: Yes.

errata.title: My attack has a rule that means it results in a critical hit on a hit roll of 4+. Does this work when snap shooting?
errata.text: Unless otherwise stated, no: when snap shooting, each attack only hits on a roll of 6.

errata.title: My attack has a rule that means it results in a critical hit on a hit roll of 4+, and I would otherwise need a 5+ to hit. Does a 4+ hit?
errata.text: Yes, except when snap shooting: when snap shooting, each attack only hits on a roll of 6.

errata.title: Are models that are within the boundary of a terrain area, but not on the ground floor of a terrain area (e.g. overhanging parts of FRAME VEHICLES or models on terrain features that are within that terrain area) within that terrain area?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: When declaring the allocation order of groups in my unit I have more than one non-CHARACTER groups that contain a model with a missing wound, how must I select the order?
errata.text: Those groups can be selected in an order of your choosing but must be in an order that makes them come before any non-CHARACTER groups that do not contain a model with a missing wound.

errata.title: I have a unit being attacked with weapons that will modify some of their save rolls to be worse then 6 should I make those save rolls?
errata.text: Yes, because other models in your unit may have Sv’s that are better those models you’ve mentioned, this means that enough save rolls could be allocated to the those models that the rest of the results are not greater then the Sv’s of the other models in your unit.

errata.title: Can I group or allocate a wound to a destroyed model?
errata.text: No.

errata.title: When my unit shoots at another unit, how does it work if some models in the target unit are fully visible to some models in my unit, while others are within a terrain area/not fully visible?
errata.text:
For each attacking model in your unit, determine whether the target unit has the benefit of cover, as described in Terrain and Visibility. In this scenario, the target unit will likely have the benefit of cover against some of the attacking models, but not all.
This means that, in an example unit where all attacking models are using the same weapon, when you get to the Resolve Attacks step of the Attack Sequence, you will collect dice for attacks made by models against which the target unit has the benefit of cover separately from the dice for attacks made by models against which the target unit does not have the benefit of cover.

errata.title: If a unit has a rule that allows it to start an action when it is battle-shocked can it also continue doing that action if it becomes battle-shocked after starting an action?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: If a unit becomes battle-shocked after starting an action does it stop performing that action?
errata.text: Yes

errata.title: Do models destroyed when a unit is out of coherency count for mission objectives?
errata.text: Yes.

errata.title: When checking coherency for my unit can my unit be in multiple groups?
errata.text: No, it must be in a single contiguous group as per Units and Models (01.02) and What is Coherency in the core rules.

errata.title: When a move says that a model or unit must move in a way if it is able, can that requirement force the unit to end their move not in coherency?
errata.text: No, when a model or unit is making a move it must follow requirements while ending that move in coherency.
